app.name: EarLab
app.tagline: An ear-training studio that runs on your own computer

home.intro: Train intervals, chords, scales, progressions, rhythm, melody, sight-reading and singing. Everything runs offline and every feature is unlocked.
home.roadmapNote: The app is built in phases. Finished parts open right away; the rest show which phase brings them.

workout.title: Daily workout
workout.body: Five games a day picked from your weak spots, refreshed at 4 AM, with a daily streak and coins. Choose your own workout games.

games.title: 18 levelled games
games.body: Intervals (harmonic, ascending, descending, comparison), chords, inversions, scales, progressions, melody, rhythm, treble/bass clef reading and singing games. Each level has 8 rounds, lives, hints and an answer-compare mode.

exercises.title: Free practice
exercises.body: Pick the intervals, chords, scales, progressions, pitches or rhythms you want and practise without limits. Listen, Compare, Play-on-piano and Read modes.

tools.title: Theory tools
tools.body: Chord progression generator, circle of fifths, scale explorer, chord player, interval memorizer, piano recorder, vocal range test, perfect pitch test, vocal warm-ups and a tuner.

learn.title: Theory course
learn.body: Seven units: Notes, Scales, Intervals, Chords, Progressions, Rhythm, Notation, with listening examples and quizzes.

stats.title: Stats & ranks
stats.body: An Ear Index built from every game, Iron → Diamond ranks, strengths and weaknesses per skill, milestones and a leaderboard across the profiles on this computer.

sound.title: Sound check
sound.body: Try the piano, intervals, chords, scales and progressions.

sound.title: Sound check
sound.intro: Click the keys or use your computer keyboard (A W S E D F T G Y H U J K = C4 → C5, Z/X change octave). Hold Ctrl and click several keys, release Ctrl to play the chord. Hold Alt and move the mouse to sweep across keys.

status.idle: Audio is off — press any button to turn it on.
status.fallback: No piano samples yet, using a synth. Run "npm run setup" to download the piano (≈2 MB).

profiles.title: Profiles & settings
profiles.listNote: Give each person a profile to keep their own progress. Data stays in this browser only.
profiles.confirmDelete: Delete profile "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
